purpose: Teach: 序文/ステートメント/コーティング/受領/取締り/移管/とりまとめ/仲間入り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社史の序文をご自身で書かれたぞ
lines.en: Your father wrote the company history's preface himself.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Gentle pride in the achievement. Soft opening, like recalling something cherished. Warm pauses between phrases.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは公式ステートメントを大事にされた
lines.en: Yes. My father valued official statements deeply.
lines.style: Quiet, respectful affirmation. Slight pause after 'Yes' — a small moment of honoring the memory. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、当社の独自コーティング技術を確立されたぞ
lines.en: Your father established our company's signature coating technology.
lines.style: Tender nostalgia. Voice slows on 'established.' Slight wonder, like witnessing something that transformed the company. Breath underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはお得意様の受領印を一つ一つ確認された
lines.en: Yes. My father verified each client's receipt stamp personally.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself. The detail carries weight — not boasting, but acknowledging the care. Quiet, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社内不正の取締りを厳格にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father enforced strict standards against internal misconduct.
lines.style: Softer than the accomplishment it names. Nostalgic, slightly solemn. Respect for the principle beneath. Trailing off gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは事業移管を巧みに行われた
lines.en: Yes. My father managed the business transition with great skill.
lines.style: Understated acknowledgment of something difficult done well. Calm, measured. A man reflecting on what was required and what was accomplished.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員意見のとりまとめを大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Your father valued collecting and coordinating the views of his staff.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. The wistfulness deepens here — this was his father's character, his care. Gentle, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界トップへの仲間入りを果たされた
lines.en: Yes. My father earned our place among the industry's top companies.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Quiet pride without fanfare. Sense of completion and peace. Voice settles into stillness at the close.
